title: Canonical site comparison intertwines the actual compact-support exchanges
statement:
For any finite commutative ring A in Type (u+1), Cartesian square of schemes, compactification c, and bounded-below etale complex K, the canonical compactSupportSiteComparisonPlus intertwines the actual proExchange with the etale compactification exchange. The source is adjusted by the inverse fixedComparisonPullbackPlus at the base, and the target by its forward component on K. All maps are the canonical maps of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps] and [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. No section or supported constant is involved, and no hypothesis is added on the new base.

theorem compact_support_site_exchange_square
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X' X B' B : Scheme.{u}} {v : X' ⟶ X} {h' : X' ⟶ B'}
    {h : X ⟶ B} {g : B' ⟶ B} (sq : IsPullback v h' h g) (c : Compactification h)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((ProEtale.compactSupportSiteComparisonPlus A c).hom.app K) ≫
      proExchange A sq c
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) =
    (ProEtale.fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A g).inv.app
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj K) ≫
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap A sq c).app K) ≫
      (ProEtale.compactSupportSiteComparisonPlus A (c.ofIsPullback sq)).hom.app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
      (ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map
          ((ProEtale.fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A v).hom.app K)

proof.text: Factor c as its open immersion followed by its proper map. Apply compactSupportProperFactor to the proper pullback square and the extension by zero of K. Properness supplies both qcqs hypotheses. The direct-image comparison is the specified counit mate.

Apply fixSiteOpenExchange to the open pullback square. It holds for arbitrary finite coefficient rings in Type (u+1) and arbitrary base change. The inverse open extension exchanges and the exact pullback comparisons have their specified unit normalizations. Restrict this equality along the fully faithful bounded-below inclusion.

Paste the proper and open equalities using naturality of the proper exchange and the target proper comparison. Expand compactSupportSiteComparisonPlus. Apply the bounded-below inclusion to the claimed identity: proExchange is by definition the preimage of the ambient compact-support exchange conjugated by the exact/left-derived and compact-support inclusion comparisons. Expand that ambient exchange into the proper mate and inverse open factor. The exact-derived adjunction unit/counit identities identify the proper mate, and the termwise extension-zero comparison identifies the open factor. Naturality cancels the intervening inverse comparisons. On the etale side derivedPlusFormalism_pfBaseChange and its open-base-change normalization identify the formalism exchange with the pasted proper/open exchange. Faithfulness of the inclusion gives the result. No finiteness property of the new base is introduced.
